source.publication: 2025 Form 760 Resident Individual Income Tax Instructions (with the 2025 Form 760)
source.section: Form 760 Lines 1-5, 8-9, 11, 12, 14-16; PDF p15 Line 4 Age Deduction and Exemptions; PDF p16 (printed Page 10) Age 65 and Older Deduction Worksheet lines 1-15; PDF p17 (printed Page 11) Taxpayers Age 65 and Older and Line 5; PDF p41 Tax Rate Schedule; Spouse Tax Adjustment Worksheet (PDF p18, printed Page 12), not applied by the projection

worked: Federal (given, not tested): Taxable Social Security (federal worksheet): gross benefits 24,000.00; provisional income = 80,000.00 + half of benefits 12,000.00 = 92,000.00; taxable = 20,400.00. Federal AGI = wages (spouse) 50,000.00 + private pension (you) 30,000.00 + taxable Social Security 20,400.00 = 100,400.00. Federal taxable income = 100,400.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 - 1 x 1,600.00 additional for age 65 or older = 67,300.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 760 Line 1 federal AGI 100,400.00. Line 2 additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 3 = 100,400.00. Income-based age deduction (you born 1957-03-10); Age 65 and Older Deduction Worksheet: line 1 = 1; line 2 FAGI 100,400.00; lines 3-6 no conformity adjustments; line 7 taxable Social Security 20,400.00; line 8 AFAGI = 100,400.00 - 20,400.00 = 80,000.00; line 9 limit 75,000.00; line 11 excess = 80,000.00 - 75,000.00 = 5,000.00; line 12 = 1 x 12,000.00 = 12,000.00; line 14 = 12,000.00 - 5,000.00 = 7,000.00. Line 4 age deduction = 7,000.00. Line 5 taxable Social Security subtracted = 20,400.00. Line 6 state refund 0.00. Line 7 Schedule ADJ subtractions 0.00. Line 8 = 7,000.00 + 20,400.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 27,400.00. Line 9 VAGI = 100,400.00 - 27,400.00 = 73,000.00. Line 11 standard deduction (Filing Status 2) = 17,500.00. Line 12 exemptions: Section A 2 x 930.00 = 1,860.00; Section B 1 x 800.00 (65 or older) = 800.00; total 2,660.00. Line 14 = 20,160.00. Line 15 Virginia taxable income = 73,000.00 - 20,160.00 = 52,840.00. Line 16 tax, rate schedule (PDF p41) as numbers: 720.00 + 5.75% x (52,840.00 - 17,000.00 = 35,840.00) = 720.00 + 2,060.80 = 2,780.80 (the form rounds to the whole dollar: 2,781.00). Line 17 Spouse Tax Adjustment 0.00 under the projection (see the note below). Credits none modelled or claimed, 0.00. Virginia income tax = 2,780.80. Combined income: only you qualify (the spouse, born 1966, does not), but married taxpayers always use joint AFAGI, so the spouse's 50,000.00 of wages brings AFAGI to 80,000.00, over 75,000, and cuts your deduction by 5,000.00. On your income alone (AFAGI 30,000.00) there would be no reduction. Spouse Tax Adjustment on the form: separate VAGI you 30,000.00 + 20,400.00 - 7,000.00 - 20,400.00 = 23,000.00, less exemptions 1,730.00 = 21,270.00; spouse 50,000.00 - 930.00 = 49,070.00; the smaller, 21,270.00, is over 17,000 and taxable income 52,840.00 is over 34,000, so the worksheet gives 259.00 (form tax 2,780.80 - 259.00 = 2,521.80); not applied (approximation).
accepted_approximations: The Spouse Tax Adjustment (Form 760 Line 17), a reduction of up to 259 for a joint return where both spouses have income, is not applied.
